metadati.dati_fino_a: Storico timestamp originale e finestre mobili aggiornate al prelievo.

metadati.note: Valori e unità della fonte; null e campi assenti non sono zero. Volumi USD degli aggregatori bridge censiti: copertura parziale, non tutti i bridge; non sommare alle transazioni sottostanti. bridges.llama.fi richiede pagamento HTTP 402 e non viene utilizzato.

methodology.BridgeVolume: From 2026-06-11 (router launch): token inflows into Socket Protocol's OpenRouter and AllowanceHolder routers — native value plus ERC20 transfers in, taking the single largest token per transaction as the routed amount; mirrors the socketprotocol/socket-data dashboard and counts both bridge and swap routing. Before 2026-06-11: deposits and withdrawals through the Socket Liquidity Layer SuperToken vaults, summed from on-chain vault events.
Sum of token amounts bridged for the period, per origin chain. We count all cross-chain transfers where origin and receiving chains are different.

USD value of assets bridged cross-chain through Lunar Finance, attributed to the source chain. Routes use LiFi, Relay, Hyperlane, Stargate, Mayan, and other bridge providers. Data from the Lunar analytics API (confirmed transactions via lunarfinance.io), filtered per source chain and time window.
methodology.Fees: User-paid bridge fees including underlying provider fees.
methodology.Revenue: Protocol fees retained by Lunar Finance.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Fees collected by the Lunar Finance treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Fees paid to underlying bridge and relayer providers (total fees minus Lunar protocol revenue).

Fees.Bridge Fees: User-paid bridge fees including underlying provider fees.

UserFees.Bridge Fees: User-paid bridge fees including underlying provider fees.

Revenue.Bridge Fees to Protocol: Protocol fees retained by Lunar Finance.

ProtocolRevenue.Bridge Fees to Protocol: Protocol fees retained by Lunar Finance.

SupplySideRevenue.Bridge Fees to Providers: Fees paid to underlying bridge and relayer providers.

methodology.Volume: Anonymized inflow series read from the SilentSwapStats reporter contract on BNB Chain (0x5894a9B8B342BDb1AD7570C3656eE406eE26f676). dailyVolume = volumeByDate(date).inflowUsd − volumeByDate(date-1).inflowUsd (clamped to ≥0). DefiLlama accumulates the running total from this daily series. Per-order gateway addresses are intentionally not exposed to preserve user privacy.

methodology.BridgeVolume: Principal dispatched into bridges by cross-chain fan-out batches on the source chain (BatchOpened events, input token, after fees).
methodology.Fees: Routing fees paid by users on each cross-chain batch swap, charged in the input token.
methodology.Revenue: The portion of routing fees retained by the Cherum protocol.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The portion of routing fees retained by the Cherum protocol.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Integrator markups paid out to third-party partners that embed Cherum.

Fees.Cherum protocol fee: Fee retained by the Cherum protocol (FeeCollected events).
Fees.Integrator fee: Markup paid to third-party integrators (IntegratorFeeCollected events).

Revenue.Cherum Protocol Fee To Protocol: Fee retained by the Cherum protocol.

SupplySideRevenue.Integrator Fee To Integrators: Markup paid to third-party integrators (IntegratorFeeCollected events).

ProtocolRevenue.Cherum Protocol Fee To Protocol: Fee retained by the Cherum protocol.

methodology.BridgeVolume: Trading volume from aggregated bridges across all chains.
methodology.Fees: Users pay a bridge fee of 1.0% on bridge transactions.
methodology.Revenue: All the bridge fees (1% on each bridge transaction) is retained by the protocol.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All the bridge fees (1% on each bridge transaction) is retained by the protocol.

Fees.Bridge Fees: Users pay a bridge fee of 1.0% on bridge transactions.

Revenue.Bridge Fees: All the bridge fees (1% on each bridge transaction) is retained by the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Bridge Fees: All the bridge fees (1% on each bridge transaction) is retained by the protocol.

methodology.BridgeVolume: USD value of filled 0x cross-chain trades, attributed to the origin chain, as reported by the 0x stats API.

methodology.Volume: USD value of successfully executed cross-chain transfers routed through Gate Swap's bridge aggregator, reported by the Gate Swap API for each hourly UTC window.

methodology.BridgeVolume: USD value of successful cross-chain transfers initiated on the chain through Allbridge Next, as reported by the Allbridge Next stats API from transfers indexed on-chain by Allbridge.
methodology.Fees: Allbridge fee (a fixed share of the transfer amount) paid by users on top of the settlement quote of every Allbridge Next transfer, in USD as reported by the Allbridge Next stats API. Settlement provider and relayer costs are part of the quoted rate and are not included.
methodology.Revenue: All Allbridge fees (a share of the transfer amount) go to Allbridge.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All Allbridge fees (a share of the transfer amount) go to Allbridge.

Fees.Allbridge Fees: Allbridge fee charged on each transfer as a share of the transfer amount.

Revenue.Allbridge Fees: Allbridge fees are kept by Allbridge.

ProtocolRevenue.Allbridge Fees: Allbridge fees are kept by Allbridge.

methodology.BridgeVolume: Cross-chain volume executed through LI.FI for integrator "hyperdex": the sent amount of every LiFiTransferStarted log carrying that integrator, on the sending chain.
Volume of completed cross-chain transfers routed through LilSwap, counted on the source chain.
methodology.Fees: Bridge fees paid by users on completed transfers.
methodology.UserFees: Bridge fees paid by users on completed transfers.
methodology.Revenue: Bridge fees retained by LilSwap after partner share.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Bridge fees retained by LilSwap after partner share.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Bridge fees paid to bridge providers and partners.

Fees.Bridge Fees: Bridge fees paid by users on completed transfers.

UserFees.Bridge Fees: Bridge fees paid by users on completed transfers.

Revenue.Bridge Fees To Protocol: Bridge fees retained by LilSwap after partner share.

ProtocolRevenue.Bridge Fees To Protocol: Bridge fees retained by LilSwap after partner share.

SupplySideRevenue.Bridge Fees To Partners: Bridge fees paid to bridge providers and partners.
